summary: LivSpan: Longevity-App mit Startscreen/Dashboard im Look eines menschlichen Genoms (vertikale DNA-Doppelhelix), mit Hauptfaktoren Ernährung, Schlaf, Bewegung und Intervallfasten als Marker entlang der Helix.
architectural_notes: Dashboard/Startscreen nutzt vertikale DNA-Doppelhelix als zentrales Layout-Gerüst; Faktoren werden als Marker entlang der Helix platziert.
Visueller Stil: filigran und wissenschaftlich (dezente Marker, clean/biologisch wirkendes Layout).

existing_features.title: Create a new LivSpan start screen/dashboard that prominently displays the four main factors: Nutrition, Sleep, Movement, and Intermittent Fasting.
Implement a coherent genome-inspired visual theme for the start screen: a vertical DNA double helix as the central layout spine, with the 4 factors positioned as subtle markers along the helix.
Add lightweight UI states for each factor marker (default, hover/focus, selected) to make the dashboard feel interactive while keeping the genome aesthetic.
Define and apply a consistent visual system for the genome theme across the start screen (colors, typography, spacing, and components), avoiding a blue/purple palette unless explicitly required.

Render the generated genome-themed static images from frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the start screen composition (background/helix/texture as appropriate) without routing image loading through the backend.
Add a subtle, continuous “scientific” helix motion to the DNA helix spine on the Start Dashboard so the helix appears to gently breathe/drift without distracting from the factor markers.
Respect reduced-motion preferences for the helix motion animation.

Implement the helix motion using the existing Tailwind setup (keyframes/animation utilities) and apply it only to the helix visuals (SVG strands/base pairs and/or the helix background layers), keeping the genome theme consistent.
